description: A developer (a Roblox group or one person) and the games they make, by one of their games or by name: who owns it, members, verified, their place among developers, players in all their games now, and each game with players now, visits and likes. With studio instead: the studio’s whole page, as RoBot reads it: who runs it, its website, X and Discord, its people and what kind each is, its Roblox groups, how its players are doing, its games (as a dataset too), the games it worked on and its latest updates.

game.description: The game: its name (like "grow a garden"), its universe id, its Roblox link or place id, or its roterminal.co/g/ link

name.description: The developer’s name, when no game is known

studio.description: The studio’s whole page: its name (like "kuzu"), its key from find (p2012478972, g16209082, u950371), or its roterminal.co or Roblox community link (optional)

name: studio
title: Who’s behind it
